name: Auction Data 2
definition: Trading phase and indicative auction price and volume.

TradingPhase.name: Trading Phase
TradingPhase.definition: Trading phase during which an order is present in the order book including trading halts, circuit breakers and suspensions.

IndicativeAuctionPrice.name: Indicative Auction Price
IndicativeAuctionPrice.definition: Price at which each auction is due to uncross in respect to the financial instrument for which one or more orders have been placed.

IndicativeAuctionVolume.name: Indicative Auction Volume
IndicativeAuctionVolume.definition: Number of units of the financial instrument, that can be executed at the indicative auction price, if the auction ended at that precise moment of time.

AuctionDataPresenceRule.definition: TradingPhase or IndicativeAuctionPrice or IndicativeAuctionVolume must be present.
